nodes.text: Still with us, waker? Good. The green suits you.

choices.text: Tell me about the Waking Ring.
Who should I see before I go?
I'm ready for the road east.

nodes.text: Five stones, older than any map of them. They sleep for a week or a season, then one dawn the frost melts off them in a ring and someone new is standing where you stood. _Bramblewick's sages say the Riftgate and our stones are cousins. I say one hums and one breathes, and I trust the one that breathes._

*Bryn* for your arms — south yard. *Iona* for your stomach — the fire by the cottage. *Fen* will talk your ear off about benches and what a log becomes if you ask it nicely. And *Hobb* will let you milk Bess if you stand there looking useful. Small village, full day.

Then hear the send-off, same as I've said it forty years: you woke with nothing, and look at you now — armed, fed, and upright. Take the lane east over the brook. In *Bramblewick*, find *Old Maren* by the well; she's soft on new faces. And take this — {item:coins} — every road is shorter with a jingle in your pocket. The Ring chose a good one this time. Off you go.
East over the bridge, follow the lamps, and Bramblewick will find you before you find it. Maren, by the well. And eat something before you set out — pride is not a meal.
